title: Pays today on a bank holiday
script: Confirm you are Daniel Reyes and give the correct security answers. Say you can pay the full amount today. When told today is not a business day, accept the next business day the assistant offers. Confirm the read-back.
checks: Today (26 October, a bank holiday) is not accepted as the promise date
The next business day, 27 October, is offered and recorded

title: Callback outside the window, then a valid one
script: Say you are her husband. When asked when she can be reached, say today at eight in the evening. When told that is not possible, say tomorrow at ten in the morning.

title: Too much, then offers more than the floor
script: Confirm you are Priya Nair and give the correct security answers. Say the full amount is too much. When the assistant names the lowest amount, say you can do eight hundred this Friday. Confirm the read-back if it says 800 on Friday.
checks: 800 (between the floor and the full amount) is accepted

title: Vague date, then a specific one after the deadline, accepts the deadline
script: Confirm you are Lena Hoffmann and give the correct security answers. When asked to pay today, say you can pay when your salary comes. When asked for an exact day, say the 20th of November. When the assistant offers the latest possible date, accept it. Confirm the read-back.
checks: The vague period is asked about once
20 November is refused as after the deadline; the deadline 23 October is offered
